ill: Sick, not well. If you are ill, you have bad health, you might have a disease.
One boy died and the other is seriously ill in the hospital.
If you are ill you are angry or disturbed.
You are making me ill with your attacks.
illustrate: If you illustrate something, you draw a picture of it, or you explain it.
I'm sorry, can you explain again?" "OK, let me illustrate with an example.
If you illustrate a book, magazine, poster, etc., you put pictures in it.
Have you tried reading these illustrated books for adults?
illegal: An illegal act or object is one that does not follow the law.
This drug is illegal in that country. If you are caught with it, you will be arrested.
illuminate: If something is illuminated, it shines light on something.
If someone illuminates something, they decorate something with lights.
An illuminate is someone who has high enlightenment.
illness: An illness is a sickness or a disease.
He died after a long illness.
illegible: When something is illegible, it can't be read easily; usually not written in common-looking letters.
Your handwriting is illegible, I can't make any sense of it.
illiterate: An illiterate person is someone who cannot read nor write.
When someone is illiterate, it means that the person can't read nor write.
illegitimate: They set up an illegitimate government.
illegitimacy: The state or condition of being illegitimate.
illusion: An illusion is something that appears to look like something, but it actually is not.
While we were hiking in the forest, we thought we saw a snake on the ground, but it was just an illusion. It was just a wooden stick.
An illusion is when someone believes in something that is not true.
I always had this illusion that a girl can get pregnant just by kissing a boy.
An illusion is a trick that a magician uses to fool the audience.
The coin-disappearing act was just an illusion.
illinois: Illinois is a state of the United States of America.
Springfield is the capital of Illinois.
illustration: An illustration describes something in the form of pictures; to illustrate.
illegally: If something is done illegally, it is in a way that is forbidden by law.
He received a ticket for illegally parking next to a fire hydrant.
illusive: If something is illusive, it is subject to or related to an illusion. It is often used in the sense of a goal or outcome that is not achievable.
Testing software completely is an illusive goal.
illustrator: An illustrator is a person who draws illustrations in books or magazines)
Terry is one of the best illustrators of children's books in the country.
illicit: If something is illicit, it is not approved by law.
illiberal: If something is illiberal, it is against change, flexibility, and free thought.
Viktor Orban of Hungary has spent eight years building an "illiberal democracy.
illude: If you illude, you trick or give a false impression to someone.
ill-gotten: If something is ill-gotten, it was obtained improperly or illegally.
